configurations.name: 🔍 Check remote consistency
configurations.command: git fetch origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $local = git rev-parse HEAD; $remote = git rev-parse origin/main; $dirty = git status --porcelain; if (($local -eq $remote) -and (-not $dirty)) { Write-Host '本地仓库和远端代码仓库 一样' } else { Write-Host '本地仓库和远端代码仓库 不一样' };
